title: The Kitchen Studio
description: A bilingual website for a custom kitchen furniture studio in Glyfada, Greece. Statically generated with Astro 7 and Tailwind 4, with a dark mode, a bilingual blog and Cloudinary-hosted imagery, deployed on Vercel.
features: Bilingual site: Greek (default) and English with i18n routing.
Full-screen hero carousel with autoplay and quick links to each product category.
Product categories: kitchens, bathrooms, doors, wardrobes, tiles, and living.
Completed projects and design studies sections.
Showroom and contact pages with a Formspree lead form.
Strict CSP headers and a subsetted icon font for fast loads.
Statically generated for fast load times and strong SEO.
